changes.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now lets you validate and roll back version upgrades
changes.detail: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports clone-based upgrades, which let you validate a new OpenSearch version alongside your current one and cut over to it only when you're satisfied. If you find a problem, you can cancel before you cut over or roll back afterward. With clone-based upgrades, you can move to new versions with more confidence. When you start a clone-based upgrade, OpenSearch Service copies the data from your existing cluster (the primary cluster) to a second cluster running the new version (the cloned cluster).
